## Contributor checks

- [ ] I used only original, abstract synthetic material; no real or realistic child disclosures, grooming text, case details, or private reviewer material are included.
- [ ] I checked that public claims match the evidence and that no model result is presented as accuracy on authentic child language.
- [ ] I did not add automatic notification, external escalation, account changes, secrets, or private weights.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and tests, or explained why they are not needed above.
- [ ] I have read the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/xyz-rafael-xyz/roguard-child-safety/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) and [contribution rules](https://github.com/xyz-rafael-xyz/roguard-child-safety/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
